title: Flash cut
description: Hard cut hidden behind a quick colour flash; use for beats, impacts and camera-flash moments.
props: {from: ReactNode; to: ReactNode; startFrame?: number /*0*/; durationInFrames?: number /*10*/; color?: string /*'#ffffff'*/}
example:
import {FlashCut} from './blocks/flash-cut/FlashCut.tsx';
<FlashCut from={<SceneA />} to={<SceneB />} startFrame={40} color="#ffffff" />
